templates.name: GoA Basic page layout
templates.description: A standard content page — microsite + app header, a left side-menu, a width-capped content column and footer. The starting point for most informational pages.

templates.name: GoA Card grid
templates.description: A responsive grid of cards with selectable filter chips. Each card groups related content with a status badge and an action. Click a chip to filter the grid.

templates.name: GoA Citizen Service Flow
templates.description: Interactive Government of Alberta citizen service — landing, multi-step application form and confirmation, wired end to end from GoA components and tokens.

templates.name: GoA Public form
templates.description: Citizen-facing multi-step form with the GoA form stepper — eligibility, details and income steps then a review, with working Back/Continue navigation and a submit state.

templates.name: GoA Question page
templates.description: One-question-at-a-time service flow with a simple progress indicator, back link and a single question per screen to reduce cognitive load.

templates.name: GoA Result page
templates.description: Post-submission confirmation — a prominent success panel with the reference number (copy to clipboard), what happens next, contact information and follow-up actions.

templates.name: GoA Review and action
templates.description: Side-by-side case-management layout for workers — case details on the left, a decision/action panel on the right with a radio choice, notes and a submit action.

templates.name: GoA Review page
templates.description: Check-your-answers page — grouped summary of everything the user entered with a Change link per row, a declaration, and a Submit action that shows a submitting state.

templates.name: GoA Service Page
templates.description: Government of Alberta service landing page — hero, intro, info callout and a start action, built from GoA tokens and components.

templates.name: GoA Start page
templates.description: The front door to a government service — what it does, who can use it, what you need, and a prominent Start button that kicks off the application.

templates.name: GoA Task list page
templates.description: Hub for a multi-step service — grouped tasks with status tags and a completion summary. Click a task to mark it done; the progress count updates. Used when a service has several independent parts.

templates.name: GoA Workspace
